user.title: ClimateRouter
user.description: Configure the two underlying thermostats, routing, manual mode, conflicts, and display compatibility.

basic.name: Thermostats
basic.description: Choose the radiator and AC thermostats and the outdoor sensor.

data.name: Name
data.ac_idle_bypass_entity_id: Device thermostat below the AC VTherm (optional)
data.ac_idle_bypass_preset: Preset used for the idle setpoint

data_description.name: Name shown on the device and its entities.
data_description.radiator_entity_id: Versatile Thermostat that controls the radiator.
data_description.ac_entity_id: Versatile Thermostat that controls the AC.
data_description.outdoor_sensor_entity_id: Temperature sensor used to choose the route.
data_description.ac_idle_bypass_entity_id: Climate entity controlled by the AC VTherm. Leave empty to use the first underlying climate reported by the VTherm.
data_description.ac_idle_bypass_enabled: In heat mode, when the AC VTherm reports idle, write the preset temperature directly to the device thermostat so it stops heating.
data_description.ac_idle_bypass_preset: VTherm preset whose temperature is used for the idle setpoint. The VTherm is expected to restore its own setpoint when heating resumes.

routing.name: Routing
routing.description: Outdoor hysteresis, handover safety, and timing.

data.fallback_on_unavailable: Fall back when a target is unavailable

data_description.cold_threshold: At or below this outdoor temperature, prefer the radiator.
data_description.mild_threshold: Above this outdoor temperature, prefer the AC. Must not be below the cold threshold.
data_description.min_route_dwell: Minimum time after a handover before automatic routing can switch again.
data_description.handover_idle_confirm: How long the old target must stay idle before it is switched off.
data_description.off_confirm_timeout: How long to wait for the old target to confirm it is off.
data_description.startup_grace: Delay before state is reconciled after Home Assistant starts.
data_description.settle_time: Ignore state changes caused by the router's own commands for this long.
data_description.fallback_on_unavailable: Use the other target when the selected one is unavailable or cannot serve the mode.

manual.name: Manual mode
manual.description: Default and maximum manual timer, and the manual/schedule lock.

data_description.default_manual_minutes: Timer for a new manual session. 0 keeps manual mode active until ended.
data_description.max_manual_minutes: Upper limit for the manual timer.
data_description.manual_blocks_schedule: Keep schedule and automation commands out while manual mode is active. The latest schedule state is remembered and applied when manual mode ends. User commands still work.
data_description.velair_enabled: Call velair.pause when manual mode starts and resume automatic control on the ClimateRouter proxy when it ends.

conflicts.name: Conflicts
conflicts.description: How direct changes to the underlying thermostats are handled.

data.auto_resolve_idle_targets: Turn off non-selected targets when idle
data.auto_resolve_simultaneous: Turn off the idle target when both are on

data_description.conflict_policy: Monitor reports conflicts, reassert resends the desired state once, adopt accepts the external change.
data_description.auto_resolve_idle_targets: Turn off a non-selected target when it is idle.
data_description.auto_resolve_simultaneous: When both targets are on, turn off the idle one.
data_description.outdoor_stale_after: Outdoor values older than this are stale; routing then holds the last target.
data_description.temperature_tolerance: Setpoint difference that counts as a mismatch.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Run both targets for a bounded time.

data_description.boost_enabled: Allow set_boost to run both targets for a bounded time.

lock.name: UI lock
lock.description: Optional accidental-touch lock. Schedule and automation commands are never blocked.

data_description.lock_enabled: Create the UI lock and block user commands while it is locked.
data_description.lock_code: Optional 4-8 digit code required to unlock.
data_description.auto_relock_sec: Relock automatically after this delay. 0 keeps the lock unlocked.

display.name: Lovelace display
display.description: Optional VTherm identity attributes for cards that auto-detect VTherm. Leave off unless needed.

data_description.expose_vtherm_identity: Expose VTherm identity attributes for cards that need them. Leave off unless required.

reconfigure.description: Change the underlying entities or any option. Values are saved together.

recalculate.name: Recalculate route
recalculate.description: Re-evaluate the route immediately, bypassing the dwell timer.

set_route_override.name: Set route override
set_route_override.description: Force routing to the radiator or the AC.

clear_conflicts.name: Clear conflicts
clear_conflicts.description: Acknowledge and clear the current conflict state.

force_handover.name: Force handover
force_handover.description: Complete a pending handover immediately, without waiting for the old target to become idle.

enter_manual_mode.name: Enter manual mode
enter_manual_mode.description: Enter proxy-owned manual mode, optionally with a value and timer.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: Timer length in minutes; 0 keeps manual mode active until switched off.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Timer length in minutes; 0 or an empty value switches the timer off.

hvac_mode.name: HVAC mode
hvac_mode.description: Manual HVAC mode. Use off to end manual mode and turn the proxy off.

set_manual_timer.name: Set manual timer
set_manual_timer.description: Set or switch off the manual-mode countdown without changing the setpoint.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Timer length in minutes; 0 or an empty value switches the timer off.

return_to_schedule.name: Return to schedule
return_to_schedule.description: End manual mode and restore the latest schedule command.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: Timer length in minutes; 0 keeps manual mode active until switched off.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Timer length in minutes; 0 or an empty value switches the timer off.

hvac_mode.name: HVAC mode
hvac_mode.description: Manual HVAC mode. Use off to end manual mode and turn the proxy off.

set_boost.name: Set boost
set_boost.description: Activate both targets for a bounded time. Requires boost to be enabled and the proxy to be heating.

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: Which targets to activate. Only both is supported in this release.

cancel_boost.name: Cancel boost
cancel_boost.description: End boost immediately and return to normal routing.

lock.name: Lock UI
lock.description: Lock user commands on the proxy. Schedule and automation commands continue.

unlock.name: Unlock UI
unlock.description: Unlock user commands. A code is required when one is configured.

code.name: Code
code.description: The configured lock code, if any.
